parameters.name: ResourceId
parameters.description: The list of resource IDs. You can specify a maximum of 50 resource IDs.

parameters.name: ResourceType
parameters.description: The type of the resource. Set the value to **DOMAIN**.

parameters.name: Tag
parameters.description: The tags. You can specify a maximum of 20 tag values.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dcdn describe-dcdn-tag-resources --resource-type DOMAIN --resource-id example.com --tag Value=product Key=env --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun dcdn DescribeDcdnTagResources --region cn-hangzhou --ResourceId.1 'example.com' --Tag.1.Key env --Tag.1.Value product --ResourceType DOMAIN
